title: それとも — or (else)
summary: A conjunction used in a question to offer two or more choices and ask which: “or?” It places an alternative after the first question. The answer is one of the options.

patterns.form: AですかそれともBですか
patterns.gloss: A or B? (コーヒーですか、それとも紅茶ですか)
choices in a question or an embedded clause

body.p: As in コーヒーにしますか、それとも紅茶にしますか, two question sentences are placed together. The first is finished and それとも brings in the next option. It also works as a question to oneself, as in 歩いて行こうか、それともバスに乗ろうか.

body.h: Compared with または and あるいは
body.p: または and あるいは list options in writing and need not be questions. それとも is used within a question to have the listener choose. It cannot be used in a non-question statement (× コーヒーを飲む、それとも紅茶を飲む).

examples.ja: コーヒーにしますか、それとも紅茶（こうちゃ）にしますか。
examples.romaji: Kōhī ni shimasu ka, soretomo kōcha ni shimasu ka.
examples.tr: Will you have coffee, or tea?

examples.ja: ここで待（ま）ちますか、それとも先（さき）に行（い）きますか。
examples.romaji: Koko de machimasu ka, soretomo saki ni ikimasu ka.
examples.tr: Will you wait here, or will you go on ahead?

examples.ja: 歩（ある）いて行（い）こうか、それともバスに乗（の）ろうか。
examples.romaji: Aruite ikō ka, soretomo basu ni norō ka.
examples.tr: Shall we walk, or shall we take the bus?

pitfalls: It cannot be used in a statement that is not a question; for ordinary lists use または.
Make the first part a question too (〜か): × コーヒーにします、それとも紅茶にしますか.
